description: Cost that cannot be attributed to any data stream, broken down by component. This is spend on things like support, inference, data transfer, snapshots, ML and platform components. Use it to explain the gap between a deployment's total invoice and the sum of its per-data-stream costs, so the numbers reconcile.

configuration.query:
FROM billing_cluster_cost_lookup
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON @timestamp >= conf_start_date AND @timestamp <= conf_end_date
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", @timestamp, NOW()) <= ?days
| EVAL cost = total_chargeable_units * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| STATS cost = SUM(cost) BY is_allocatable, cost_category, deployment_name
| SORT cost DESC
| LIMIT 100
